sections.bio: I spent years building software that runs PT/OT/SLP practices. Scheduling, clinical notes, insurance billing, ERA posting, denial management, prior auth... all of it.  I help PT/OT/SLP practices fix what their current software breaks. Denied claims, disconnected tools, manual workflows that should have been automated years ago. Sometimes that is a new build. Usually it is integrations, automation, and fixing the gaps between systems they already have. HIPAA IT certified. I have built compliance into production systems from scratch. Not read about it, built it. If you run a rehab therapy practice and your software is costing you more than it should, DM me.
